narrative: Micron disclosed 16 take-or-pay Strategic Customer Agreements locking in roughly $100 billion of minimum revenue plus $22 billion of upfront customer cash -- a concrete look at how AI-memory capacity is being pre-financed, with buyers paying forward to secure allocation. That is the same buildout-funding pressure, surfacing on the supplier's books rather than a hyperscaler's earnings call.
remaining_gap: Today shows supplier-side prepayment, not a hyperscaler detailing a named bond, term-loan, or off-balance-sheet structure for its compute buildout.
